items.headline: Fed holds rates steady, signals patience as core inflation drifts toward target
items.summary: The FOMC left the policy rate unchanged for a third meeting, reiterating data dependence. Dot-plot still implies cuts later in 2026 but officials pushed back on near-term easing bets.

items.headline: Dollar firms as Treasury yields hold; 2s10s curve stays modestly positive
items.summary: The broad dollar index edged higher as the 10-year held near recent levels and the 2s10s spread stayed slightly positive, consistent with a late-cycle, steady-policy read.

items.headline: New tariff review targets additional tech and industrial import categories
items.summary: Officials opened a review of tariff lines covering semiconductors, capital equipment, and select industrials. No final rule issued; affected supply chains face headline risk into the summer.

items.headline: Middle East tensions lift crude; Brent and WTI add over 2% on supply-risk premium
items.summary: Energy prices rose on renewed regional tension and shipping-route concerns. Strategists flagged the move as a potential upside risk to headline inflation if sustained.

items.headline: ECB on hold, BOJ edges toward another hike — global rate paths diverge
items.summary: The ECB held while signaling caution; the Bank of Japan continued to lean hawkish. The widening policy gap kept FX volatility elevated across major crosses.

items.headline: Credit spreads stay tight; high-yield demand signals risk appetite intact
items.summary: High-yield OAS held near cycle tights as investors kept reaching for carry, a risk-on tell despite the steady-policy backdrop and lingering geopolitical headlines.

items.headline: Industrial production ticks up; soft-landing narrative holds for now
items.summary: The latest industrial-production print rose modestly, keeping the growth-momentum read positive and supporting a late-cycle-but-not-contracting characterization of the regime.
